Source Monster

Monster: Zamtrios | CR: 5 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

(Light Bowgun only) When you hit a creature with your water ammo it must make a @Check[constitution|dc:14] saving throw or have its movement speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn on a failed save. On a successful save, the creature's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet.

Armor Effect

(Spellcaster only) This armor has 2 runes, which it regains daily at dusk. While wearing it, you can expend a rune to cast @spell[armor of agathys].

Tags: weapon-type:light-bowgun, mechanic:saving-throw, mechanic:movement, type:offensive, class:spellcaster, mechanic:rune-charges, mechanic:spell:lvl1-2
